key_decisions.decision: Retains the source’s divine agency rather than harmonizing the parallel account’s adversary.
Keeps the compressed geographic sequence without pretending its syntax is certain.
Retains the obscure pinned place names rather than reconstructing them from other witnesses.
Preserves Samuel’s two totals and its differing descriptions of the groups.
Keeps the striking-heart image, confession, and request without supplying the census’s unexpressed motive.
Retains pinned seven years, three months, and three days rather than harmonizing the famine duration.
Follows read mercies and preserves the deliberate us-to-me shift.
Keeps the unspecified appointed endpoint and full death count.
Follows read Araunah and retains relenting, command, and the angel’s location.
Keeps David’s repeated personal responsibility and the sheep image without changing it into a narrator’s innocence verdict.
Retains the difficult title attached to Araunah instead of silently deleting or relocating it into speech.
Keeps emphatic purchase, cost, exact price, and scope rather than importing the parallel account’s amount.
